_comment: Coverage ratchet floors (ADR 0048). `make coverage` fails if line coverage drops below these. When coverage rises, the ratchet prints the new floors to commit here. Set a hair below current to absorb measurement noise.
_commentDirs: Per-directory floors (G15, ADR 0096 dec. 4 amendment 2026-09-08) go under each layer's own `dirs: { "<key>": <floor> }` — frontend keys: src/screens/<name>, src/ui, src/shared, src/app, src/api, src/(root) (catch-all for every other measured file under src/); Rust keys: src-tauri/src/<top-level-dir> or src-tauri/src/(root). `dirs` is REQUIRED once present for a layer (missing → the gate fails with a --seed hint); a pinned key with no measured coverage fails unless its directory is gone from disk; a key NEW relative to the base revision's baseline (COVERAGE_BASE_REF) must measure and pin >= 70%, and an existing key's pin may never read lower than at base. Bootstrap with `node scripts/check/coverage-ratchet.mjs --seed [--layer=frontend|rust]` against the coverage-summary.json artifacts, then paste the printed block in by hand. Intentionally absent here until the integrator seeds it from a CI run's uploaded summaries.
